sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Multilayer active circuitry moves from experiments into ordinary semiconductor products.
reference.rationale: Early stacked/specialized devices made the direction real, but a broad transition to genuinely three-dimensional circuitry was only partial in 2009. Samsung’s mass-produced 3D V-NAND from 2013 establishes commercial multilayer circuits. The word “common” need not mean every processor has become 3D.

broader.criterion: Include stacked dies and specialized sensor/MEMS structures as 3D chips.
broader.rationale: The author’s retrospective cites pre-2009 commercial examples under this expansive definition. On-time success is plausible on that reading; independent prevalence evidence is thinner.
